clue.text: Pudding and veg may be served as a single item

definitions.text: Pudding and veg may be served as a single item

parts.note: a sweet is a British name for a pudding or dessert course
a potato is the commonest vegetable on the plate

explanation.surface: A diner is told dessert and vegetables might arrive together on one plate.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue does both jobs: the pudding word and the vegetable word, served together, name one root vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: This orange-fleshed tuber is a single vegetable whose name joins a dessert word to a spud.

clue.text: Apostle's food served up in the city

parts.note: the apostle Peter, with his saint's title and the possessive kept as a letter

indicators.note: in a down clue, served up means the food word is written bottom to top

parts.note: grub is slang for food

explanation.surface: An apostle's dinner is brought to the table somewhere in town.
explanation.definitionFit: The Russian port founded by Peter the Great is a major city on the Neva.

clue.text: Take off Times Educational leader?

parts.note: eras are periods or times

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, here of Educational

explanation.surface: Someone is asked to remove the editorial from the Times Educational Supplement.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests the Times Educational Supplement; the two words are split apart.
explanation.definitionFit: To take something off a page or tape is to rub it out or delete it.

clue.text: There's nothing on top of Everest

definitions.text: There's nothing on top of Everest

parts.words: There's nothing on top of Everest
parts.note: at the summit the atmosphere is very rarefied, and the phrase also means nothing at all, as in vanishing into it

explanation.definitionFit: The rarefied atmosphere at altitude also stands idiomatically for nothingness, as things vanish into it.

clue.text: Owt foul when flushed down the pan?

definitions.text: Owt foul when flushed down the pan?

indicators.note: flushing churns things about, so the letters of the two words are mixed up

parts.note: owt is northern English dialect for anything; the two words are taken as written

explanation.surface: Anything nasty goes away when the toilet is flushed.
explanation.definitionFit: What drains from a lavatory pan when flushed is a stream of discharge leaving it.

clue.text: Gangster getting a rod can be unsettling

parts.note: Al Capone is the archetypal gangster
a rod is slang for a gun, so getting one is taking up arms

explanation.surface: A mobster acquiring a gun is a worrying development.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rod' is old American slang for a pistol.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that unsettles or frightens people is disturbing or worrying.

clue.text: One person that's glad with decrepitude?

definitions.text: One person that's glad with decrepitude?

parts.words: One person that's glad with decrepitude?
parts.note: a retired elderly person receives a state payment because of advanced years, so is glad to be old

explanation.definitionFit: A retired elderly person drawing a state allowance is someone whom advanced years have rewarded.

clue.text: Withdraw from walkover in contest

indicators.note: in places the walkover abbreviation inside the word for a contest

parts.note: a bout is a boxing or wrestling contest
w.o. is the abbreviation for a walkover in sport

explanation.surface: A competitor pulls out of a match, leaving a walkover in the contest.
explanation.definitionFit: To bow out is to retire or step down from an activity.

clue.text: Warning signal could be a trick

parts.note: be is the verb in its bare form
a con is a swindle or trick

explanation.surface: A warning light might really be a ruse.
explanation.definitionFit: A fire lit on a hill to warn of danger is the classic signal light.

clue.text: Artful paper that's folded?

parts.note: the Japanese craft turns a folded sheet into art

explanation.definitionFit: The Japanese craft makes models and art by creasing sheets without cutting.

clue.text: Model with swaying gait? Rubbish!

parts.note: the Model T was Ford's famous car
a waddle is a walk that rocks from side to side like a duck

explanation.surface: Someone scoffs at a catwalk model who walks unsteadily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Model' suggests fashion, but it is Ford's Model T.
explanation.definitionFit: Nonsense or empty talk is dismissed with this exclamation of contempt.

clue.text: Where varnish gets paid for in cash?

definitions.meaning: nail varnish is applied to a fingernail
paying promptly in cash is paying on the spot, an idiom from old market counters

explanation.surface: A manicurist is paid immediately in cash.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means paid at once, from bargains settled on a counter post; nail polish literally sits there.

clue.text: Mysterious power of a soldier surrounded by decoration

indicators.note: surrounded by puts the letters for a and soldier inside the decoration

parts.note: MC is the Military Cross, a British gallantry award
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier wearing a medal seems to have uncanny strength.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorcery or supernatural power is a mysterious force beyond explanation.

clue.text: The unknown third parties?

parts.note: the third person plural pronoun is used for unnamed people, as in what people say

explanation.definitionFit: The third-person plural pronoun is used for vague unnamed people, as in the saying 'so people say'.

clue.text: One may keep note on board

definitions.text: One may keep note on board

parts.words: One may keep note on board
parts.note: a thumbtack holds a memo on a noticeboard, while the surface suggests a ship

explanation.definitionFit: A thumbtack pinning a memo to a corkboard keeps a note in place.

clue.text: A gel formulated in leaves?

indicators.note: formulated means made up to a new recipe, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A gel is concocted from plant leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: This trade name for petroleum jelly is the best-known greasy gel.

clue.text: Train Borg, a great Swedish player

indicators.note: to train is to drill and shape, so these letters are reformed

parts.note: taken as written; Björn Borg is the Swedish tennis star
taken as written

explanation.surface: A coach is told to work with Björn Borg, a great Swedish tennis player.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's Swedish player is the tennis star; the answer is the Swedish film actress.
explanation.definitionFit: The Swedish-born film star was a celebrated screen actress, a player in the theatrical sense.

clue.text: Country with a musical sound

indicators.note: a sound means the word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: Grease is the 1970s musical set in a high school

explanation.surface: A nation is known for its tuneful music.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mediterranean nation with Athens as its capital is a country.

clue.text: Flight controller in a role that's unusual

indicators.note: something unusual is out of the ordinary, so these letters are set out differently

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An air traffic controller is working in an unfamiliar job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flight controller' suggests air traffic control; it is a hinged part of a wing.
explanation.definitionFit: This hinged flap on a wing controls an aircraft's roll, so it governs flight.

clue.text: Burns night? Is that when one gets lit up?

definitions.text: Burns night? Is that when one gets lit up?

parts.words: Burns night? Is that when one gets lit up?
parts.note: a big outdoor fire burns at night and is lit up, while Burns Night is the Scottish poet's supper

explanation.definitionFit: On 5 November Britons light big outdoor fires, so the event is literally a night of burning.

clue.text: Animals chanted about?

parts.note: the antelopes are the subject of a well-known comic song, and their name is heard like news, something talked about

explanation.definitionFit: These African antelopes, also called wildebeest, star in a famous comic song.

clue.text: Doctor's cure said in part to transfix?

indicators.note: only part of the phrase, the possessive s and the following word, is spoken aloud

parts.note: the possessive s run into the word cure gives the sound needed

explanation.surface: A physician's remedy is said to involve piercing someone.
explanation.walkthrough: Only part of 'Doctor's cure' is used: the 's and 'cure' together, spoken, give the answer's sound.
explanation.definitionFit: To spear something through with a thin pointed rod is to pierce and pin it.

clue.text: Directions for a girl to follow

parts.note: E and N are the compass directions east and north
Sue is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Instructions are given for a young woman to go after someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To come after as a consequence is to result or succeed.

clue.text: Munich let in chaos, when we could do with a break

definitions.text: when we could do with a break

indicators.note: chaos is disorder, so these letters are thrown into disorder

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Munich allowed chaos in at a time when everyone needed a rest.
explanation.definitionFit: The midday meal hour is the break in a working day.

clue.text: The male beast can become agitated

parts.note: he is the male pronoun
a tup is a ram, the male sheep

explanation.surface: A male animal may get worked up.
explanation.definitionFit: Being worked up or flustered is a state of agitation.

clue.text: Palace hanger-on has no time for a messenger

indicators.note: has no means one letter is taken away from the royal attendant

parts.note: a courtier attends at a royal palace

explanation.surface: A royal attendant is too busy to bother with a messenger.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone carrying parcels or messages is a dispatch rider or envoy.

clue.text: With mixed tennis a little bit of emotion can become strained

indicators.note: mixed suggests mixed doubles but signals jumbling these letters
a little bit of a word is its opening letter, here of emotion

explanation.surface: Mixed doubles tennis with a touch of feeling can get tense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixed tennis' suggests mixed doubles; 'mixed' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Highly concentrated or tense describes a state of strain.

clue.text: Crop for fresh sergeant with club

parts.note: green means fresh or unripe
Sgt Pepper led the Lonely Hearts Club Band on the Beatles album

explanation.surface: A new sergeant arrives carrying a cudgel to harvest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'club' is not a weapon but the Beatles' Sgt Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band.
explanation.definitionFit: The capsicum grown and harvested as a vegetable is a farm crop.
